(Wayne Partlow/AP) Signing up for a new health insurance plan through the federal marketplace is a bit more challenging this year, as applicants face additional requirements to prove they aren't committing fraud.
 Here & Now 's Robin Young speaks with Julie Appleby , a correspondent for KFF Health News, about how the changes are affecting Affordable Care Act open enrollment.
 This segment aired on November 11, 2026.
